notes: BUU 2.1.1 - bulletproof logout + debug fixes. LOGOUT: no more stuck sessions. Each worker verifies its own logout (loads a PestPac page, confirms the login screen) and won't quit until confirmed; when the pool finishes or stops, BUU sweeps the License Manager and logs out any session still showing as BUU - even from crashed workers - never touching real employees. New 'Log out stuck sessions' button. FIXED: workers no longer vanish on a second run; a wrong-sheet warning appears before launch instead of silently skipping every row; step drag-and-drop double-line, auto-scroll, and chip drop; worker cards no longer shift left on wide windows. NEW: stop a single worker (it finishes its row, logs out, requeues the rest); build flows while the pool runs; setup/teardown scope (per worker / per job / global).
